meta.title: Meet by the Tall Tree
meta.textType: dialogue: where and when to meet

paragraphs: On Monday, Teacher Nick gave his class a new project. Each child worked with one friend and grew a small plant. Tom chose Ben, and Ben chose Tom. "Which day can we make a plan?" asked Tom. "Not Tuesday," said Ben. "I have football with Coach Matt on Tuesday." "Wednesday is free for me," said Tom. "Lessons finish at half past three on Wednesday." "Good," said Ben.

"Where shall we meet?" asked Tom. "The classroom is closed after school," said Ben. "Let's meet by the tall tree next to the school gate." "I go to the canteen first and buy a snack." "Then let's meet at a quarter to four," said Tom. "I can bring the plant and the soil." "I have two cups at home," said Ben. "I can bring them to school in the morning." Tom wrote on his hand, "Wednesday, tall tree, quarter to four."

On Wednesday morning, Tom walked to school with Lily and Pip. "I come home late today," he told her. "I meet Ben by the gate after school." "Shall I tell Mom?" asked Lily. "Yes, please," said Tom. "Don't worry. I am not going home alone," said Lily. "I am going with Pip and Mia."

At a quarter to four, Tom stood by the tall tree. He had the plant in his bag, and he waited alone. Ben ran to the gate with two cups in his hands. "Sorry! Am I late?" he asked. "No, you are just on time," said Tom. They put the soil in the cups and put the plants in the soil. "Now we need water," said Ben. They did a good job together.
text.summary: Tom and Ben must make a plant project together. They talk about the day, the time, and the place to meet, and then they meet by the tall tree.
